AUTHORITY=NICOLAS
CONTROL_FRONT=OJO
MODE=EXECUTE_NOT_REINVESTIGATE
PROFILE=FAST_SAFE

MISSION=F3C_CANNONICO20B_REVERIFY_AND_REPAIR

CURRENT_PROVEN_FACTS:
- New GROQ_API_KEY was validated locally with HTTP 200 against https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/models.
- Existing bridge com.novaera.sol-github-bridge was restarted after launchctl setenv GROQ_API_KEY.
- SUPRA Chat VERIFY_ONLY returned:
  STATUS=FAIL
  PROVIDER=unknown
  MODEL=openai/gpt-oss-20b
  CONTENT=empty
  ERROR=VERIFY_ONLY mode has no verification capability for openai/gpt-oss-20b without Azure OpenAI deployment context; capability/preset skills target Azure OpenAI only.
- Therefore the Groq credential is no longer the primary proven blocker.
- Canonical historical F3C contract says:
  provider=cannonico_20b
  capability=CANNONICO_20B_REASONING
  model=openai/gpt-oss-20b
  endpoint=https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions
  ToolOrchestrator is NOT buggy and MUST NOT be patched.
  raw patrimony must stay local; cloud receives only minimal sanitizedPacket.
- F5 remains PROVEN_PASS/FROZEN. DO_NOT_TOUCH.

DO NOW, SEQUENTIALLY:
1) Recover the EXISTING installed/local F3C cannonico_20b provider implementation, its composition-root registration, tests and latest execution artifact from the authoritative runtime. Do not global-scan.
2) Prove whether provider=cannonico_20b is registered and reachable independently of Chat VERIFY_ONLY.
3) Treat the Chat VERIFY_ONLY Azure-only error as a diagnostic-route mismatch unless evidence proves the actual cannonico_20b provider is also misregistered.
4) Validate the existing cannonico_20b outbound request against Groq Chat Completions:
   endpoint=https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions
   model=openai/gpt-oss-20b
   required=model,messages
   max_completion_tokens for max output
   reasoning_effort only low|medium|high if used
   never send local/Ollama-only parameters.
5) Run existing offline/unit tests first. Preserve previous pass baseline.
6) If offline tests pass, perform MAXIMUM ONE tiny synthetic sanitized real call through the ACTUAL SUPRA routing path using provider=cannonico_20b. No patrimony.
7) If the provider path fails due to registration/adapter/config, make the SMALLEST bounded correction ONLY in the existing cannonico_20b provider/adapter or its F3C registration. Do NOT patch ToolOrchestrator, F5, routing precedence, privacy policy, or generic chat behavior.
8) Re-run offline tests, then at most one real call if still needed.
9) Return exact proof of provider, model, non-null content and provenance.
10) If cannonico_20b is proven operational, update only the relevant runtime/provider receipt. Do not invent mission/V3 success.
11) Nicolas must not be asked to paste secrets or perform work unless a genuine external human-only gate remains.

NO_NEW_ENGINE=YES
NO_NEW_BRIDGE=YES
NO_NEW_RUNTIME=YES
